title: ConsumptionAggregated
description: Total consumption over a grid cell and a period. The analytical counterpart to meter-read-recorded, per the rule that a producer needing both views emits two events. Keys on `cell`, never on a meter: an aggregate over a handful of meters is a household read wearing a hat, which is why `meter_count` has a floor.

utility.description: Utility network. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

asset_ref.description: Feeding substation. Class is narrowed to exclude `meter`: a meter identifier in a 90-day store re-identifies a household.

period_start.description: Start of the aggregation period, inclusive.

period_end.description: End of the aggregation period, exclusive.

total.description: Total consumption over the period in `unit`.

unit.description: Unit of `total`. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

meter_count.description: Meters contributing to the aggregate. Floored at 5 so that a single premises cannot be isolated from the aggregate.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
